description: A client-side JavaScript file for managing and displaying test results, including image diffing, test selection, and result loading in a web-based test result viewer.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Initializes event listeners, loads configuration and results, and starts the test result viewer.

methods.name: displayResults
methods.description: Groups test results by failure type and populates the failure type selector.

methods.name: enableSorting
methods.description: Enables sorting of tests by metric and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: disableSorting
methods.description: Disables sorting of tests and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: selectFailureType
methods.description: Populates the directory selector based on the selected failure type.

methods.name: selectDirectory
methods.description: Populates the test selector based on the selected directory and failure type, with optional sorting.

methods.name: getSelectedTest
methods.description: Returns the currently selected test name.

methods.name: selectTest
methods.description: Displays detailed results for the selected test, including images and text outputs.

methods.name: loadTextResult
methods.description: Loads and displays text-based test result data.

methods.name: displayTextResults
methods.description: Loads and displays expected, actual, and diff text results for a test.

methods.name: nextTest
methods.description: Selects the next test in the list, skipping disabled options.

methods.name: previousTest
methods.description: Selects the previous test in the list, skipping disabled options.

methods.name: updateState
methods.description: Updates UI elements to reflect the current test's state.

methods.name: displayImageResults
methods.description: Loads and displays expected and actual images for a test, and initiates diff computation.

methods.name: updateImageDiff
methods.description: Computes and displays a visual diff between expected and actual images.

methods.name: prefetchNextImageTest
methods.description: Preloads images for the next test to improve performance.
